scene: High in the pine needles, three scenic transit decks stretch below.
picture: Pixel art flat side view. The grandfather stands on a wooden branch platform pushing his bicycle with plant crate. Far left, a sleek bento express train waits on an aerial track. At the centre, a koi-shaped boat floats beside a mooring post. Far right, a red retro streetcar idles at a rooftop stop.
shown: A sleek bullet train with an open door waiting on tracks far left
A wooden koi-shaped boat floating by a small pier at the centre
A red retro streetcar idling with doors open on rails far right
